description: A 5 V development board with a Renesas RA4M1 Cortex-M4 at 48 MHz, in a Minima and a WiFi variant, with the UNO header layout, a 14-bit ADC and a DAC on A0.
summary: The board runs the user's sketch in the iynk interpreter. Pins, PWM, I2C, serial and timing follow the uno-r4 board profile. It is not the Renesas RA4M1 chip.

models.1: Arduino-C++ subset run by the interpreter with the UNO R4 pin map, 32-bit int and 64-bit double.
models.2: Digital I/O on D0 to D13 and A0 to A5, PWM on D3, D5, D6, D9, D10 and D11, interrupts on D2 and D3.
models.3: Analog reads up to 14 bits with analogReadResolution, I2C master on SDA and SCL, serial output, and the L LED on D13.

not.1: Renesas peripherals other than digital I/O, I2C and serial.
not.2: The 12x8 LED matrix library and the ESP32-S3 radio of the WiFi variant.
not.3: The DAC on A0 as an analog output value.
not.4: The 8 mA pin source limit is not enforced.

gap: The WiFi variant is modelled as the Minima: the LED matrix and the radio do nothing. No electrical ratings are listed yet, so no pin-overload check exists for this board.
